name: learnflix
description: Assista aos cursos que estão nas suas pastas, com progresso confiável.
author: OnaitsirC-MiromA

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=server" "npm run dev --workspace=web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=web && node scripts/gerar-bundled.mjs && npm run build --workspace=server && node scripts/empacotar.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=server && npm run test --workspace=web
